_README: TRADE GROW VERIFICATION CHECKLIST. This replaces the 'trust score' idea deliberately.
A trust score is a number we award ourselves. A checklist is a set of facts a customer can check.
RULE: 'verified' may only be set when (a) the fact is published on this site with a number or document, AND (b) a customer can confirm it from an independent source we link to.
Do not mark an item verified because it is internally true. Mark it verified when it is externally checkable.
